mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the picture showed that oxygen can attach and later be released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the red cells to plasma was straightforward and felt more like assembly than a decision, though it helped build the final picture.

surprise.text: I was surprised that mature red blood cells were shown without nuclei.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary, although the final step named defenders and leak-sealing parts without clearly explaining which component does which job.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how blood carries different materials made me curious about where it goes next.
